title: CleanGutters Lighting vs Princeton Gutters: Gutter Services Compared
body_markdown:
If you live in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania or Northern Delaware, **CleanGutters Lighting is the pick when you want owner-installed stainless steel micro-mesh [gutter guards](https://cleangutterslighting.com/services) with a transferable lifetime warranty**. Princeton Gutters is the pick only if it serves your address and puts its materials, warranty and installer in writing.


**TL;DR**

- CleanGutters Lighting wins on documented specifics: 18 years in business, 1,000+ homes, surgical stainless steel micro-mesh.
- Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally, not subcontractors.
- Choose Princeton Gutters only if it serves your ZIP and matches the written terms below.
- For cleangutters lighting vs princeton gutters in 2026, compare warranty transfer, mesh material and who is on your roof.


## Why this matters in 2026

Gutter work looks identical on a quote sheet and very different on your roof ten years later. The gap between two companies is rarely the price on day one. It is the mesh material, who does the install, and whether the warranty survives a home sale.

This comparison puts CleanGutters Lighting next to Princeton Gutters on the points that decide the outcome. Every CleanGutters Lighting claim below comes from the company's own stated service, guarantee and track record. Where Princeton Gutters' terms are not published in the data behind this page, the table says "Get it in writing" instead of guessing. That is the honest position, and it is also your checklist for the quote call.

**The axis of difference:** CleanGutters Lighting is built around one high-performance product, micro-mesh gutter protection, installed by the owner. The question for Princeton Gutters in 2026 is whether it can match that on paper.

## At a glance

| Dimension | CleanGutters Lighting | Princeton Gutters |
|---|---|---|
| Best for | Homeowners who want micro-mesh guards and one accountable installer | Homeowners inside its service area who confirm the terms below |
| Service area | South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania, Northern Delaware | Check your ZIP before booking |
| Standout feature | Surgical stainless steel micro-mesh, 22+ inches of rain per hour handled | Get it in writing |
| Experience | 18 years, 1,000+ homes | Ask for years and job count |
| Installer | Alex installs every job personally | Ask who is on the roof |
| Warranty | Transferable lifetime warranty | Ask if it transfers to a buyer |
| Extra services | Gutter cleaning, repair, permanent roofline LED lighting | Ask what is included |
| Pricing model | Quote-based, no pressure, no fine print | Get a written itemized quote |

## CleanGutters Lighting has the proven track record

CleanGutters Lighting has been installing gutter protection for 18 years and has worked on 1,000+ homes. That is a number you can verify with local references, and it is the first thing to ask any competitor for.

Track record matters because gutter systems fail slowly. A crew that has seen ten winters of pine needles, maple seeds and ice on the same product knows what holds up. A newer operation is still learning on your house.

- **CleanGutters Lighting:** 18 years, 1,000+ homes.
- **Princeton Gutters:** ask for the founding year and the number of completed installs, then ask for three addresses nearby you can drive past.

**Verdict:** CleanGutters Lighting, on the numbers it publishes.

## CleanGutters Lighting uses a higher-grade mesh

The core CleanGutters Lighting product is surgical stainless steel micro-mesh. Micro-mesh blocks shingle grit, seeds and pine needles that slip through wide screens and perforated covers. Stainless steel does not warp, rust or sag the way cheaper plastic and thin aluminum inserts can.

CleanGutters Lighting rates its LeafBlaster Pro micro-mesh to handle 22+ inches of rain per hour. That figure exceeds any rainfall rate you will see in a typical New Jersey downpour, so water goes into the gutter instead of over the front edge.

Ask Princeton Gutters three questions:

1. What is the mesh made of, exactly?
2. Is it micro-mesh or a wider screen or perforated cover?
3. What rainfall rate is the product rated to handle?

If the answers are vague, that is your answer. For homeowners who want the lowest upkeep, the same logic runs through our guide to the [best low-maintenance gutter guards for elderly homeowners](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/best-low-maintenance-gutter-guards-for-elderly-homeowners).

**Verdict:** CleanGutters Lighting offers the stronger, better-documented product.

## CleanGutters Lighting puts the owner on your roof

Alex installs every CleanGutters Lighting job personally. These are not subcontractors, and the person who quotes the job is the person who hangs the guards.

That structure has practical effects. Pitch problems get fixed instead of covered over. Fascia damage gets flagged before the guard goes on. If something is wrong a year later, you know exactly whose name is on it.

Many gutter companies sell through a sales rep and install through a rotating crew. That model is not automatically bad, but it spreads accountability thin. Ask Princeton Gutters directly whether its own employees or subcontractors do the work, and whether the person who measures your house is the person who installs.

**Verdict:** CleanGutters Lighting, by a clear margin on accountability.

## The warranty is where cleangutters lighting vs princeton gutters gets decided

CleanGutters Lighting backs its micro-mesh gutter protection with a transferable lifetime warranty. Transferable matters: when you sell, the warranty goes to the buyer and becomes a selling point instead of a lapsed document.

A lifetime warranty that stops at the first owner is a much smaller promise than it sounds. Before signing with Princeton Gutters or anyone else, get these in writing:

- Does the warranty cover the mesh, the frame and the labor?
- Does it transfer to the next owner, and is there a fee?
- What voids it? Clogs from neglect, roof changes, storm damage?
- Who honors it if the installer is a subcontractor who disappears?

**Verdict:** CleanGutters Lighting leads on the terms it states. Princeton Gutters can close the gap with a written transferable warranty.

## Service area: check your ZIP first

This is the one dimension where Princeton Gutters can win outright. CleanGutters Lighting serves South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania and Northern Delaware. If your home sits outside that footprint, the comparison is moot, and a provider that actually serves your address beats one that does not.

A good installer who can reach you quickly also means faster repairs and warranty visits. Confirm travel range and response time with whoever you hire, because a warranty is only as useful as the crew's ability to show up.

**Verdict:** Depends on your address. Whichever company serves your ZIP and documents its terms wins.

## CleanGutters Lighting covers more than guards

Beyond micro-mesh guards, CleanGutters Lighting provides professional gutter cleaning, gutter repair and permanent exterior roofline LED lighting. That is useful for a specific reason: gutters should be clean and sound before guards go on, and one contractor handling cleaning, repair, guards and lighting means one set of hands on your fascia and eaves.

The roofline lighting runs on the same hardware logic as the gutters. A single crew that already knows your roof edge can install lighting without a second contractor drilling into the same trim. See how installers stack up on craft in our ranking of [permanent roofline lighting installers by craftsmanship](https://cleangutterslighting.com/blog/permanent-roofline-lighting-installers-ranked-by-craftsmanship).

If you only need a single narrow service from Princeton Gutters and its terms check out, that is a legitimate reason to choose it. Do not pay for a bundle you will not use.

**Verdict:** CleanGutters Lighting for a full-roofline plan; a tie if you need one narrow service and both serve you.

## Pricing: compare models, not just numbers

No pricing for either company is published in the data behind this page, so no dollar figures appear here. What you can compare is the pricing model.

CleanGutters Lighting works from a quote with no pressure and no fine print. You get a number, an explanation, and no clock ticking on a "today only" discount. That predictability is the point.

When you compare quotes, force every bid onto the same basis:

- Linear feet of gutter covered
- Mesh material and product name
- Whether cleaning and repair are included before the guards go on
- Warranty terms and transferability
- Who installs

A low quote that skips pre-cleaning and uses a thinner screen is not cheaper. It is a different product.

**Verdict:** A tie until you hold two itemized quotes. The cheapest line item rarely wins over ten years.

## Final verdict

**Choose CleanGutters Lighting if** you live in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania or Northern Delaware, you want surgical stainless steel micro-mesh, and you want the owner on the roof with a transferable lifetime warranty behind the work. Visit [CleanGutters Lighting](https://cleangutterslighting.com/) to see the full service lineup.

**Choose Princeton Gutters if** it serves your address, it gives you the mesh material, rainfall rating and warranty transfer terms in writing, and it matches the 18-year, 1,000+ home standard you can verify locally.

**The quotable version:** For cleangutters lighting vs princeton gutters in 2026, CleanGutters Lighting is the stronger choice for homeowners in its three-state service area who want owner-installed micro-mesh with a transferable lifetime warranty.

| Service area | Whoever serves your ZIP |
| Full-roofline services | CleanGutters Lighting |

For homeowners in South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania and Northern Delaware, CleanGutters Lighting is the stronger documented choice in 2026. It offers 18 years of experience, 1,000+ homes and a transferable lifetime warranty. Confirm Princeton Gutters' written terms before deciding.

CleanGutters Lighting installs surgical stainless steel micro-mesh. The fine mesh blocks shingle grit, seeds and needles that wider screens let through. It is rated to handle 22+ inches of rain per hour.

Yes. The lifetime warranty on its micro-mesh gutter protection is transferable. That helps at resale because the next owner inherits the coverage.

**Who installs the gutter guards at CleanGutters Lighting?**

Alex installs every job personally. CleanGutters Lighting does not use subcontractors, so the person who quotes your job is the person on your roof.

**What should I ask Princeton Gutters before hiring?**

Ask what the mesh is made of, what rainfall rate it handles, who installs, and whether the warranty transfers to a buyer. Get every answer on the written quote.

**Does CleanGutters Lighting only install gutter guards?**

No. CleanGutters Lighting also provides professional gutter cleaning, gutter repair and permanent exterior roofline LED lighting across its three-state service area.

**Where does CleanGutters Lighting work?**

South Jersey, Eastern Pennsylvania and Northern Delaware. If your home is outside that area, choose a provider that serves your address.


## One last thing

The most useful move before you sign anything in 2026 is to ask each company for the address of a job they installed at least five years ago, then look at how the guards and fascia hold up.
